definitions.gloss: soil quality; soil type; nature of the soil
definitions.explanation: The physical and chemical properties of soil, including its composition, texture, drainage, and fertility. Used in agriculture, construction, and earth sciences.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{土質|どしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧よい。
examples.english: This field has good soil quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{土質|どしつ}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A soil survey was conducted before construction.

examples.japanese: {土質|どしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{粘土質|ねんどしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水|みず}はけ→水はけ：20340_mizuhake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧、⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}たまり→水たまり：19427_mizutamari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦でき→できる：00557_dekiru⟧やすい。
examples.english: In places where the soil is clayey, drainage is poor and puddles tend to form after rain.

notes:
A compound of {土|ど} (earth/soil) and ⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧ (quality/nature). Used in both agricultural and civil engineering contexts to describe the characteristics of soil at a given location.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土質|どしつ}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: soil investigation; geotechnical survey
- {土質|どしつ}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: soil test
- {土質|どしつ}⟦{改良|かいりょう}→改良：09681_kairyou⟧: soil improvement
- {土質|どしつ}⟦{工学|こうがく}→工学：04862_kougaku⟧: geotechnical engineering

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{土壌|どじょう}→土壌：12040_dojou⟧: soil (broader term, often used in agriculture and environmental science)
- ⟦{地質|ちしつ}→地質：04055_chishitsu⟧: geology; geological properties (focuses on rock and deeper earth layers, not just surface soil)
- ⟦{地盤|じばん}→地盤：04035_jiban⟧: ground; foundation (the structural quality of the ground for building)
